name: Astral Courthouse
summary:
WUH OH! You're in BIG trouble with the Astral Courthouse, Heaven's one and only courthouse, again! Ya know for someone in Heaven, you sure are evil as Hell! Anywho, to avoid execution you must pass the trials the court challenges you with. Avoid angelic creatures, collect 'shinies' and try to get off innocent!

Made for the Gamedev.JS jam with the theme "Balance", hence where the Court, and Justice Scale theming came in.
